column1: # One row per SHIPPED SURFACE, adjudicated against the book (SIGNOFF-REPAIR.11.4.6.2).
# ⛔ THE POPULATION IS DERIVED, NEVER TYPED. Route families and unfamilied routes
# come from every `.route(` outside a #[cfg(test)] block in the server's src/;
# binaries come from `cargo metadata --no-deps`, because only 4 of the 10 carry a
# [[bin]] stanza. A member this file does not judge FAILS the gate.
# ⛔ THE WITNESS IS THE EVIDENCE, NOT THE VERDICT, and the guard re-checks it:
#   - route-family / route : `<total routes>:<route keys the book does not name
#     beside an HTTP method>` — RECOMPUTED every run. A route added, removed,
#     documented or undocumented since the judgement detaches the row.
#   - binary : `<chapter>::<verbatim substring>` — the sentence somebody actually
#     read. A binary has no /v1/ path to match and `rb` is two letters, so a
#     mention test cannot carry this judgement. A rewritten sentence detaches it.
# ⭐ THE REFUSAL IS THE FEATURE. A detached witness means a judgement is OWED.
# Re-read the surface; do NOT paste the computed witness over the old row, which
# converts a stale verdict into a fresh-looking one.
# ⛔ A `gap` MUST NAME AN OWNING LEAF (CLAUDE.md §15: a finding nobody owns is a
# complaint), and `gap` and `internal` must both carry a reason.
# ⚠️ `covered` means the book names EVERY route of the member beside a method.
# That is a proxy: a contract line is not proof the description is accurate or
# ⚠️ THE VERDICT IS NOT READ OFF `census_book_coverage.py`. That instrument asks
# *does any chapter mention this family* and calls 21 of 30 covered; asked per
# ROUTE only 14 of 30 are. It also under-reports: `/` is mechanically a bare
# mention and web-ui.md is a whole chapter about it. Both corrections are here.
